title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Sezar Nedir: Sezar; kurs, spor salonu, diş kliniği ve oto kiralama gibi randevu, kayıt ve tahsilat yapan işletmeler için geliştirdiğimiz bir yönetim yazılımı. Ürün canlıda ve müşterilerimiz günlük işlerini Sezar üzerinden yönetiyor. Mobil erişim, e-posta bildirimleri, SMS entegrasyonu ve ödeme altyapısı üzerinde de çalışıyoruz. Neler Yapacaksın - Ürünün yeni özelliklerini uçtan uca geliştirmek: veri modeli, sunucu tarafı iş kuralları, arayüz - Sektöre özel sürümleri (diş, spor salonu, oto kiralama vb.) esnek bir çekirdek üzerinde kurmak - Canlı ortamın güvenliğini, yedeklemesini ve dağıtımını birlikte sahiplenmek - Ödeme sağlayıcısı, e-posta ve SMS gibi dış servis entegrasyonlarını yürütmek - Kod kalitesi, test ve sürüm disiplini için standartlar belirlemek - Müşteri geri bildirimini doğrudan dinleyip ürün kararlarına katkı vermek Aradığımız Özellikler - TypeScript ile 3 yıl üretim seviyesinde geliştirme deneyimi - React ve Next.js (App Router, sunucu bileşenleri) ile çalışmış olmak - PostgreSQL ile veri modelleme, sorgu optimizasyonu ve şema değişikliği (göç) yönetimi - Kimlik doğrulama, yetkilendirme ve veri izolasyonu konularında somut deneyim - Linux sunucu, Git ve temel ağ/güvenlik bilgisi - Kararlarını gerekçelendirip yazılı olarak paylaşabilmek - Yapay Zeka araçlarını etkili şekilde kullanbilmek Olursa İyi Olur: - Çok kiracılı (multi-tenant) SaaS deneyimi - Ödeme sistemleri, faturalama veya e-fatura bilgisi - Yedekleme, izleme ve olay yönetimi - Açık kaynak katkısı ya da yayımlanmış bir proje Nasıl Çalışıyoruz: - Küçük bir ekip, kısa karar zincirleri, her değişiklik kayıt altında - Ürünün sahibi olma: teknik kararlar sende, sonuçların sorumluluğu da sende - Çalışma modeli: Hibrit

title: Full Stack Developer (React & C#) – E-ticaret
description: E-ticaret operasyonlarımızı büyütmek için hem yazılım geliştirme hem de ikas ve Ticimax altyapılarında ileri seviye mağaza yönetimi yapabilecek bir ekip arkadaşı arıyoruz. Aranan Nitelikler Frontend - React ile en az 2 yıl deneyim (hooks, context, state yönetimi, component mimarisi) - JavaScript (ES6+) ve TypeScript bilgisi - DOM manipülasyonu ve DOM elemanlarıyla etkileşim: element seçimi, event handling, MutationObserver, dinamik içerik yönetimi - Tailwind CSS ile responsive / mobil uyumlu arayüz geliştirme - REST API ve GraphQL entegrasyonu deneyimi Backend - C# ve .NET Core / .NET 6+ ile en az 2 yıl deneyim - ASP.NET Core Web API ve .NET MVC ile proje geliştirme - MS SQL veya PostgreSQL, Entity Framework Core - Üçüncü parti API entegrasyonları (pazaryeri, kargo, ödeme, ERP) Debug ve Hata Ayıklama - Chrome DevTools ile ileri seviye debug: Elements, Console, Network, Sources, breakpoint kullanımı - React Developer Tools ile component ve state analizi - Loglama ve hata izleme (Posthog, Sentry vb.), production hatalarını analiz edip kök nedenini bulabilme Performans Optimizasyonu - Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) ölçümü ve iyileştirmesi; Lighthouse ve PageSpeed Insights kullanımı - React tarafında memoization, lazy loading, code splitting ve gereksiz render'ların önlenmesi - Görsel optimizasyonu (WebP / AVIF, lazy load, CDN) - Backend'de sorgu optimizasyonu, indeksleme, caching (Redis, in-memory) ve asenkron programlama AI Destekli Geliştirme - Claude, Claude Code, Google Antigravity, Cursor, GitHub Copilot gibi AI kodlama araçlarını günlük iş akışında etkin kullanma - AI çıktısını eleştirel gözle inceleyip doğrulayabilme E-ticaret Altyapıları (ikas & Ticimax) Ürün, Kategori ve İndirim Uyarlama - Ürün, varyant ve kategori yapısının mağaza ihtiyacına göre kurgulanması ve uyarlanması - Ürün ve kategori bazlı indirim kuralları: yüzde / tutar indirimi, kategoriye özel fiyatlandırma, tarih aralıklı kampanyalar - X al Y öde, 2. ürüne indirim, sepet tutarına göre indirim ve kupon kurgularının ikas ve Ticimax'te kurulması - Platformun standart kampanya modülünün yetmediği durumlarda özel indirim mantığının geliştirilmesi Vitrin, Kampanya ve Satış Kanalları - Tema / vitrin özelleştirme, banner, menü ve sayfa düzeni yönetimi - Satış kanalı yönetimi; Trendyol, Hepsiburada gibi pazaryerleriyle ürün, stok ve sipariş senkronizasyonu 3rd Party Uygulama Geliştirme - ikas App Store ve Ticimax için 3rd party uygulama (app / eklenti) geliştirme - OAuth ile mağaza yetkilendirme, uygulama kurulum ve yaşam döngüsü yönetimi - Admin paneline gömülü arayüzler ve storefront'a script / widget enjeksiyonu - Uygulamaların çoklu mağaza (multi-tenant) mimarisinde çalışacak şekilde tasarlanması Entegrasyon ve Otomasyon - ikas Admin API (GraphQL) ve Ticimax web servisleri (SOAP / REST) ile entegrasyon geliştirme - Toplu ürün güncellemelerini script ve API ile otomatikleştirme - Webhook ile sipariş, stok ve ödeme olaylarının takibi - Kargo, ödeme (sanal POS) ve muhasebe / ERP entegrasyonları Genel - Git ve versiyon kontrol kullanımı *İş Tanımı* - ikas ve Ticimax altyapılarında ürün, varyant, kategori ve kampanya yönetimini yürütmek - ikas ve Ticimax için 3rd party uygulamalar geliştirmek - Şirket içi araçlar ve entegrasyonlar için React + C# (.NET MVC / Web API) geliştirmeleri yapmak - Toplu ürün güncellemelerini AI araçları ve script'lerle otomatikleştirmek - Sitenin performansını, SEO'sunu ve kullanıcı deneyimini iyileştirmek Başvurmak için özgeçmişinizi ve varsa GitHub / portfolyo linkinizi iletebilirsiniz.

title: Full Stack Developer 8+
description: Aranan nitelikler • Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği veya Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun •        En az 8 yıl deneyimli •        Arka yüz (back-end) tarafta Java (Spring, Spring Boot) ile yazılım geliştirme deneyimi olan •        Ön yüz (front-end) tarafta React ve TypeScript ile uygulama geliştirmiş •        REST ve GraphQL API tasarımı, WebSocket ile gerçek zamanlı veri aktarımı konularında tecrübesi bulunan •        AWS üzerinde bulut tabanlı (Cloud-Native), mikroservis ve çok kiracılı (Multi-Tenant) uygulamalar geliştirmiş; AWS servisleriyle (Amazon EKS, AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, AWS AppSync, Amazon Cognito, Amazon S3, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, Amazon OpenSearch Service vb.) üretim ortamı tecrübesi bulunan •        İlişkisel veritabanları (PostgreSQL) ve arama motorları (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch) ile çalışmış •        Kimlik yönetimi ve yetkilendirme (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, Keycloak vb.) ile yetkilendirme modelleri (RBAC / ABAC) konusunda tecrübesi bulunan •        Konteynerizasyon (Docker) ve orkestrasyon (Kubernetes) ortamlarında (tercihen Amazon EKS) uygulama geliştirip dağıtmış; AWS SDK, IAM rolleri ve AWS üzerinde güvenli uygulama mimarisi konularına hakim •        Olay güdümlü (Event-driven) sistemlerde ve mesajlaşma altyapılarında (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ vb.) çalışmış •        Birim, entegrasyon ve uçtan uca testler yazma alışkanlığı olan; CI/CD ve DevSecOps yaklaşımında tecrübesi bulunan •        Güvenli yazılım geliştirme (OWASP Top 10) prensiplerine hakim •        Çok iyi derecede İngilizce bilen (yazılı, sözlü) Tercihen •        Daha önce NATO, Savunma Sanayii (C2 – Komuta Kontrol Sistemleri) veya istihbarat projelerinde görev almış olan •        Harita ve coğrafi görselleştirme kütüphaneleriyle (MapLibre, OpenLayers, CesiumJS vb.) çalışmış; NATO APP-6 / MIL-STD-2525 sembolojisine aşina olan •        Veri görselleştirme ve pano (dashboard) geliştirme (D3.js, ECharts vb.) konusunda tecrübe ve vizyon sahibi olan •        Yapay zeka ve LLM entegrasyonu (sohbet arayüzleri, ajan akışları, RAG) içeren uygulamalar geliştirmiş olan •        Açık Kaynak İstihbaratı (OSINT) konusunda tecrübe sahibi olan •        Büyük veri setlerini tarayıcıda performanslı gösterme (sanal listeler, WebGL vb.) konusunda çalışmış olan •        Erişilebilirlik (WCAG) ve çok dilli arayüz (i18n) geliştirme tecrübesi bulunan •        AWS Certified Developer – Associate veya AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate sertifikasına sahip olan

title: Backend Developer – Mobil Bankacılık
description: 📍 Lokasyon: İstanbul – Ümraniye 🏢 Çalışma Modeli: Tam zamanlı 📌 Proje Hakkında Andevos Bilgi Teknolojileri olarak, bankacılık sektöründe yürüttüğümüz mobil uygulama projesinde görev alacak Yazılım Uzmanı arıyoruz. Pozisyonun temel odağında, mobil uygulamanın ihtiyaçlarına özel olarak konumlandırılacak BFF katmanının geliştirilmesi ve bankacılık sistemleriyle entegrasyonunun sağlanması yer almaktadır. 🎯 Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği, Yönetim Bilişim Sistemleri, Matematik, İstatistik veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun, Bankacılık veya finans teknolojileri projelerinde backend geliştirme deneyimi bulunan, Java veya .NET teknolojilerinden en az biriyle uygulama geliştirmiş, Mobil uygulamalara veya dijital kanallara hizmet eden backend servisleri geliştirmiş, BFF mimarisi veya mobil uygulama ile backend sistemleri arasındaki servis katmanlarında deneyimli, REST API, web servisleri ve mikroservis mimarileri konusunda bilgi sahibi, Bankacılık ana sistemleri ve çevresel sistemlerle entegrasyon geliştirmiş, Uçtan uca işlem akışları ve işlem doğrulama süreçlerinde çalışmış, DOP işlem akışları veya benzer bankacılık süreçlerinde deneyimli, Codevo veya benzeri işlem doğrulama sistemleriyle entegrasyon geliştirmiş, CMS entegrasyonu ve içeriklerin mobil uygulamaya sunulması süreçleri hakkında bilgi sahibi, SQL ve ilişkisel veri tabanları konusunda deneyimli, Yazılım geliştirme yaşam döngüsü, versiyonlama ve test süreçlerine hâkim, Kodlama, hata analizi, test ve teknik dokümantasyon çalışmalarında yapay zekâ araçlarını aktif olarak kullanan, Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme becerileri güçlü. ⭐ Tercih Sebepleri Keycloak veya benzeri kimlik doğrulama ve yetkilendirme sistemleriyle çalışma deneyimi, Mobil güvenlik SDK’larının entegrasyonu konusunda bilgi, Yüksek işlem hacmine sahip bankacılık uygulamalarında deneyim, Agile çalışma yöntemlerine aşinalık. Codevo, DOP ve kullanılan diğer sistemlerde birebir deneyim zorunlu değildir. Benzer işlem doğrulama, çevresel sistem entegrasyonu ve içerik yönetimi çözümleriyle çalışmış adaylar da değerlendirilecektir. 🔐 KVKK Bilgilendirmesi LinkedIn üzerinden elektronik ortamda iletmiş olduğunuz kişisel verileriniz, Andevos Bilgi Teknolojileri ve Pazarlama A.Ş. tarafından, 6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (“KVKK”) kapsamında veri sorumlusu sıfatıyla; şirket bünyesinde doğabilecek mevcut ve ileride oluşabilecek istihdam olanaklarının değerlendirilmesi amacıyla işlenecek, güvenli bir şekilde muhafaza edilecek ve yalnızca bu amaçla kullanılacaktır. İlgili ilana başvurarak, özgeçmişinizin ve ilettiğiniz kişisel verilerin şirket veri tabanında saklanmasına rıza gösterdiğinizi kabul etmiş sayılırsınız.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer - Lumos (Remote)
description: Who We Are ( Mode.Inc ) Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities. Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built. Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company’s success. You can read more about our team and how we work here . The Role Mode is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go expertise to join the engineering team responsible for Lumos, our recently acquired VPN product, while also supporting the development and integration of future acquired products. You will help take technical ownership of an existing production VPN following its acquisition by Mode.Inc. Your initial focus will be understanding and stabilizing the existing backend and Go networking engine, closing technical and security gaps, and establishing the engineering foundations needed to evolve the product confidently to a consumer VPN with 10M+ installs, 1,000+ servers in 45+ countries, and users in some of the most restrictive network environments in the world. That engine, a Go library cross-compiled for Android and iOS that embeds a userspace TCP/IP stack and drives the Shadowsocks and WireGuard clients, is the core of the product, and you will be the engineer who understands it, hardens it, and extends it. We are a user-facing product-led team, and we are looking for someone who is passionate about building private, secure, and resilient systems that people depend on every day. As an engineer, you’ll be accountable for taking over, stabilizing, and evolving an existing backend: nimbly experimenting with solutions, building high-quality software, and measuring results. You’ll own the account, subscription, and server-selection APIs, the WireGuard peer and configuration pipeline, and the integrations with payments, analytics, and attribution providers. You’ll establish automated testing, API documentation, and CI/CD where they don’t exist yet, close the security gaps identified during due diligence, and use agentic AI coding tools as a core part of your daily workflow. You’ll work closely with the mobile frontend engineer, DevOps/network engineer, product managers, operations, and several stakeholders to define and execute according to our strategic roadmap to accelerate our future growth. Who You Are and What You’ll Do You are passionate about giving people private, secure, and unrestricted access to the internet. You care about your users and the trust they place in the product. You enjoy inheriting an existing system, reading unfamiliar code, and reverse-engineering how things work, then making them better with tests, documentation, and refactoring. You’re an exceptional Go backend engineer with strong networking fundamentals and comfortable across a polyglot backend (Go, Python, Node.js), and you are not afraid to go low-level: raw IP packets, userspace network stacks, proxy and tunnel protocols, and cross-compiling Go for mobile. You design APIs that mobile clients love: clear contracts, versioning, graceful degradation, and documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger) that the frontend team can build against without asking. You embrace agentic AI as a force multiplier: you use AI coding agents to plan, implement, test, and review work, and you know when to trust them and when to verify. You value working closely with Product Management, learning directly from users about what matters to them, and developing solutions that they love. You care deeply about the impact of your work, and measure success by the value added to users’ lives: connection success rate, API latency and error rates, and subscription conversion and retention. You’re excited to write high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested code that you deliver. You are eager to find minimal ways to test hypotheses and validate feasibility. You’re a strong advocate for unit/integration testing and passionate about automated testing and continuously shipping to production. You are security-minded: secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, cryptographic key generation and handling, least-privilege access, and user privacy are part of everyday engineering, not an afterthought. What You Bring to the Team Must Have: 5+ years of professional senior backend engineering experience in an agile environment delivering services that support native mobile applications, with hands-on production experience using: Go as a primary language: concurrency (goroutines, channels), networking (net, netstack-style packet handling), cgo/gomobile or similar cross-compilation for Android (.aar) and iOS (.framework/XCFramework) Python and Node.js for existing services, scripts, and integrations PostgreSQL (schema design, migrations, performance) and MongoDB or another document store, plus Redis or similar caching AWS: Lambda, S3, RDS, Route 53, IAM, and Docker-based services; familiarity with Terraform/Ansible-managed environments REST API design and documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger), authentication (JWT/OAuth), and rate limiting GitHub for version control and pull-request based workflows; SOLID, Clean Coding, Testing, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar) VPN and networking expertise: working knowledge of WireGuard (peer/key management, configuration generation), Shadowsocks or other proxy/obfuscation protocols, OpenVPN, TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, and how packets flow from a mobile OS tunnel interface through a userspace stack (lwIP, gVisor netstack) to a VPN server. Experience integrating and operating third-party platforms: Stripe and in-app purchase validation (App Store Server API, Google Play Developer API), analytics and attribution (Amplitude, Firebase, AppsFlyer/Adjust or similar), and observability (Datadog). Applied security engineering: secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager/SSM), encryption of sensitive data at rest, safe cryptographic key generation and storage, dependency and vulnerability scanning, and remediating audit findings. Agentic AI proficiency : demonstrated day-to-day use of AI agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot agents) to write and review infrastructure code, automate runbooks, and investigate incidents, with strong judgment on verifying AI-generated output before it touches production. You’re a candid and empathetic communicator that is excited to join a startup that enjoys leveling up a company. You have exceptional organizational and analytical skills leading to confident independent delivery, but know when and how to include others. You have experience building large-scale systems with some technical leadership skills. Passionate about Technology and keeping up to date with latest advancements, techniques and best practices. Alignment with our Core Values: Accountable : You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement. Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, timely execute, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done. Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment. Curious: You focus on the ‘why,’ learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve. Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance. Nice to Have: (Strongly preferred) Experience building or maintaining a consumer VPN, proxy, or privacy backend, especially censorship-circumvention tooling (Shadowsocks plugins, V2Ray/Xray, obfs4) and server-selection / load-balancing logic across a global fleet (Strongly preferred) Contributions to or deep familiarity with wireguard-go, gVisor netstack, lwIP, or Shadowsocks implementations in Go (Strongly preferred) Experience operating multi-provider infrastructure (AWS plus DigitalOcean, Vultr, Hetzner) and Cloudflare (Strongly preferred) Event-driven and workflow systems (SQS, step functions, job queues) and building resilient integrations with dependency chains and fallbacks Compliance and data-governance experience (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2), including data retention policies and handling law-enforcement / data requests for a privacy product Kotlin or Swift literacy for pairing with mobile engineers on library integration Experience taking over and integrating acquired products or codebases First 30 days Understand the existing backend and Go networking engine Map critical services, dependencies and data flows Establish local development/debugging workflow Identify highest-risk reliability/security issues Contribute to 100% uptime. 60 days Own meaningful production changes Improve test coverage around critical paths Close priority technical gaps from due diligence Establish better observability/documentation where needed Contribute to 100% uptime. 90 days Independently own backend/VPN-engine initiatives Improve connection reliability / API reliability Reduce operational/manual pain Contribute confidently to product and technical roadmap Contribute to Uptime at world class market levels for similar products. We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms Allow OKRs to Guide Us Assume Positive Intent Agree to Disagree & Commit Set New Precedents Accomplish More with Less Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards Speak Up Be Resourceful Follow the 80/20 Rule What We Are Offering We are a 100% remote-first, global company. A competitive compensation package. We offer generous perks & benefits to team members. Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full-time team members). We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program. Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people. Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones. Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies. Bonusly - We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment. Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings). Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full-time team members). If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together! Mode.Inc does not accept/pay fees for unsolicited resumes from third-party agencies/vendors. Our company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Senior Full Stack (.NET & Vue) Developer
description: We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join a large project that is already well underway, with substantial development still ahead. About Mouseless We are an independent developer collective where people take ownership of what they build and how they build it. At mouseless, ownership goes beyond writing code. It means understanding the problem, shaping the solution, making technical decisions and taking responsibility for the outcome. You will work directly with the people involved in building the software. Your code is read by people who understand the whole system, technical decisions are discussed openly, and everyone contributes to the quality of what we deliver. We value people who are curious, take initiative, challenge assumptions and actively shape the way the work gets done. How we work We build in small increments, each with an owner and a reviewer. Your first draft PR comes on day one. Specifications are written as automated tests. We plan continuously, adjusting priorities and scope as we learn more. When something turns out to be bigger than expected, we narrow the scope rather than compromise on quality. We take our commitments seriously. When we make a promise to a client or to each other, we do our best to deliver on it. We believe reliability comes from taking ownership, communicating openly and working together to find a way forward. What we work with C#, .NET, Vue and Nuxt What we’re looking for 5+ years of professional experience with C# and .NET in production environments. Hands-on experience building and maintaining frontends with Vue, ideally with Nuxt. If your frontend experience comes from another modern framework, we expect the fundamentals to be solid and the willingness to work in Vue to be genuine. Comfort moving across the full stack: you are at home in the API layer and in the browser, and you understand how decisions on one side shape the other. Strong understanding of software design and domain modelling. Test automation as a natural part of your development process. Experience working with and evolving existing codebases. Ability to make thoughtful technical decisions and explain the reasoning behind them. Initiative in improving the codebase, engineering practices and development process. A collaborative mindset and a sense of ownership that extends beyond your own tasks. The position Our office is in Kadıköy, Istanbul. Hybrid work is possible, but we prefer working together in the office most days. Close collaboration is an important part of how we work. Before you apply Our work is public. Take a look at our open pull requests on github.com/mouseless to get a feel for how we build software and work together. Apply through LinkedIn and we will get back to you.

title: Java Backend Developer
description: About the Job Company Description OBSS is Turkey’s largest technology consultancy, pioneering product development and technology consulting for an AI-native future. With more than 20 years of experience and offices in London, Istanbul and Ankara, we empower leading companies in banking and finance, insurance, e-commerce, retail, and the start-up ecosystem. Our team of over 1000 talented professionals thrives on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. We are now looking for a Senior Java Backend Developer with strong Oracle PL/SQL and Oracle Forms experience to join our international projects team and contribute to building high-quality, end-to-end digital solutions for global banking transformation projects. As a Senior Java Backend Developer, you will work on rewarding, large-scale international projects to design, build, and maintain innovative backend software solutions for the banking sector. You will play a key role in core banking transformation initiatives, combining modern Java architectures with legacy database and forms capabilities while working alongside global project teams. Main Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain secure, compliant, and scalable banking-related backend software solutions for international projects. Implement robust back-end Java applications alongside core database logic using Oracle PL/SQL and Oracle Forms. Design workflow applications and process-driven backend solutions using BPM tools, specifically IBM BAW (Business Automation Workflow). Integrate back-end web services, databases, and client systems via REST and SOAP APIs. Apply advanced design patterns and microservices architecture to ensure high scalability, security, and performance. Create standard-compliant, secure backend code and maintain comprehensive technical documentation. Collaborate with cross-functional international teams to deliver end-to-end digital banking applications. Qualifications / Technical Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of backend software development experience, preferably within the banking sector (experience in banking transformation projects is a strong plus). Mandatory hands-on experience and deep expertise in Java , Oracle PL/SQL , and Oracle Forms .
